scientific_boundary: These workflows evaluate source discovery, identifier-preserving retrieval, provenance, and promotion controls. They do not establish causality, validate biomarkers, recommend treatment, or support patient-level decisions.

scenarios.question: Can a reproducible evidence packet preserve the ESR1 identity while retrieving terminology matches, gene relationships, regulatory-link counts, and bounded drug-repositioning hypotheses for breast neoplasms?
Can the same reviewed tool set preserve the EGFR identity and assemble terminology, gene-regulation, and computational hypothesis evidence for lung neoplasms?
Can the reviewed operations produce a provenance-linked terminology, TP53 identity, regulatory-link, and hypothesis packet for colorectal neoplasms?
Can a scanner-discovered workflow preserve the BRAF identity while retrieving melanoma terminology, regulatory-link counts, and bounded drug hypotheses?
Can the same governed workflow preserve the PTEN identity and assemble terminology, regulatory-link, and computational hypothesis evidence for prostatic neoplasms?

accepted_operations.description: Resolve a reviewed cancer term to bounded OMOP concept records from COHD.
accepted_operations.interpretation: The response is a terminology search result from a deidentified aggregate dataset. Returned concepts require semantic review and counts are not incidence estimates.

accepted_operations.description: Retrieve reviewed HGNC symbol relationships for one exact gene symbol.
accepted_operations.interpretation: The response supports gene-symbol normalization only; it is not tumor-expression or functional evidence.

accepted_operations.description: Retrieve bounded linked-data counts for one reviewed gene entity.
accepted_operations.interpretation: Linked-entity counts describe records in the provider's regulatory knowledge hub; they do not quantify biological effect or clinical relevance.

accepted_operations.description: Retrieve five reviewed computational drug-repositioning hypotheses for one MeSH disease identifier.
accepted_operations.interpretation: These are model-ranked hypotheses for research triage, not efficacy evidence or treatment recommendations.

rejected_operations.description: Qualification-only EBI protein candidate used to test response-schema enforcement.
rejected_operations.expected_error_substring: Provider response failed the reviewed schema
rejected_operations.failure_summary: The live accession value is scalar where the published response schema requires an array.

rejected_operations.expected_error_substring: Provider response failed the reviewed schema

rejected_operations.expected_error_substring: Provider response failed the reviewed schema
